怎么切换英文 / 繁体字？: How do I switch to English / Traditional Chinese?
点左上角「☰ 更多」，夜间模式下面有一排「简体 / 繁體 / English」，: Tap “☰ More” at the top left. Under Night mode there is a row “简体 / 繁體 / English”; tap one to switch, and it stays that way next time you open the site. Simplified Chinese is the default.
